about: Dropsea's Browse Versions… and Browse Backups over the platform's backups (docs/adr/0059-backups.mdx, step 3; OxyHQ/Dropsea#53): a real oxyos-backupd --development backed the run's home up twice before the run (notes.txt changed between), then notes.txt changed again and plan.txt was deleted. notes.txt selected, File › Browse Versions… lists its two versions, the newest chosen; Restore asks as a Mac does, since a notes.txt is there, and Keep Both writes the backup's notes beside it as Time Machine names it, “notes (original).txt”, the notes there now untouched. File › Browse Backups shows the home as the newest backup held it, plan.txt among its items though it is gone; plan.txt chosen and restored goes back where it was, under its own name. Every step checks the disk.

steps.name: Dropsea opens at the home, Browse Versions… and Browse Backups offered: a backup disk keeps backups
File › Browse Versions…: its versions, newest first, in a sheet
the versions are listed (asked of the service, restic's find), under Today
Restore: a notes.txt is there, so Dropsea asks as a Mac asks
Keep Both: the backup's newest notes beside it, as Time Machine names it; the notes there now untouched
File › Browse Backups: the home as the newest backup held it, plan.txt among its items though it is gone
Restore: plan.txt back where it was, under its own name
